values.meaning: remaining cooldown reduction on Arc of Judgment upon entering/exiting the state
values.quote: has its {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}} reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state

mechanics.claim: During Transcendent State, Cultivation of Spirit automatically activates at no cost, with its duration extended to Transcendent State's duration.
mechanics.quote: Automatically becomes active at no cost, with the duration increased to ''Transcendent State's''.

mechanics.claim: Casting Transcend One's Self also casts Cultivation of Spirit, granting an attack reset if it was not already active.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}} is cast alongside ''Transcend One's Self''. If the former was not already active, this will also grant its {{tip|basic attack reset|attack reset}}.

mechanics.claim: The attack reset from casting Cultivation of Spirit is not attributed to Transcend One's Self itself, e.g. for the purposes of Hail of Blades.
mechanics.quote: The attack reset does '''not''' originate from ''Transcend One's Self'' nor is ''Transcend One's Self'' tagged as granting one itself (e.g. for the purposes of {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).

mechanics.claim: During Transcendent State, Arc of Judgment is upgraded into Arc of Ruin, which costs no mana.
mechanics.quote: Upgraded into ''{{ai|Arc of Ruin|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}} reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.

mechanics.claim: During Transcendent State, Kanmei's Steps is upgraded into Untouchable Shadow, which costs no mana and has its cooldown reset upon both entering and exiting the state.
mechanics.quote: Upgraded into ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}'', which has no cost and has its {{sti|cooldown}} reset upon both entering and exiting the state.

mechanics.claim: An ongoing Kanmei's Steps effect is not lost when quickly replaced by Untouchable Shadow.
mechanics.quote: An ongoing ''{{ais|Kanmei's Steps|Yunara}}'' effect is not lost when quickly replaced by ''{{ai|Untouchable Shadow|Yunara}}''.

mechanics.claim: Transcend One's Self cannot be recast while its Transcendent State is already active.
mechanics.quote: ''Transcend One's Self'' cannot be cast again while active.
